svg.title: Forms that each language file reads
svg.desc: Matrix of 16 language files by 22 forms. en reads 22; pt reads 20; fr reads 18; de reads 17; it reads 15; es reads 14; eu reads 14; nl reads 14; ru reads 12; ca reads 11; ar reads 10; zh reads 10; tdt reads 7; el reads 5; ja reads 3; ko reads 3.
